This land is not mine — I only rent it, so I will not spend much money on it. For my cassava and cocoyam here in the South South, the rains are good and the soil still gives something, so I do not buy chemical fertilizer. I will spread some household ash and compost I have gathered. I plant cuttings from last year's harvest like my neighbours do, and I weed carefully with my children's help. I may call one or two people to help me clear and make the heaps at the start.
